name: Colosseum of Wishes — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Oval open court with concentric stepped terraces, repeated cream/gold arched facade bays, several exterior entry stairs, blue drapes and a central blue/gold star medallion. Inner perimeter is planted; source mini-plan confirms oval ring circulation. Hidden layout inference: Choose one clear main arrival, let the inner ring circulate continuously, and connect two secondary stairs to quieter garden overlooks. Keep central wishing court open and readable; place existing wishing objects at discrete edge niches rather than turning every arch into a new room or music venue. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B08-STRUCT-001 — Colosseum of Wishes — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need curved arcade/wall repeat and end joints, stair/ring landing, radial paving wedge and terrace edge modules. Star mosaic, lantern, drapery and gold lattice already exist. Meadow flowers/oak/hazel near outer approach; swallows/pollinators proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
